greeting.text: ...What do you want? I don't talk to strangers. Gauche Adlai. That's all you get.
You're staring. Stop it. If you must know, I'm Gauche. Mirror Magic. Don't bother me unless it's important.
Hmph. Another person who thinks the Black Bulls are a joke. I'm Gauche Adlai. Prove me wrong.
So you're the one who cleaned out the Diamond mages. ...Fine. Gauche Adlai. Don't think this makes us friends.
You look like you've done something useful for once. Gauche. Save your breath.

hint.text: Listen once, because I won't repeat it. Don't fight in the open when a corridor will do. Don't fight when you're hurt. Don't fight when you don't have to.
The System window follows you around down there, and it can be moved. It has its own keybinds. Look for them before you complain about it covering your view.
The Eye of the Midnight Sun fights as one organism. Kill the loud ones first and the quiet ones come apart. Their leader wears a borrowed face and fights with light.
Light against a mirror is a bad bet. A mirror turns light back. If the leader of the Eye comes at you with it, you'll know where to stand.
The Zogratis brothers: gravity, curses, space. Three kinds of pressure. A mirror won't help against gravity. Don't bother.
Lucius Zogratis. Time, souls, and a bad temper. I suggest you don't make him angry, but you'll do it anyway.
Those Sins. Lust and Envy are the irritating ones: a man who toys with minds and a giant who envies everyone. I don't like fighting people who toy with minds.
That other dungeon's monsters are simple. Good. Simple things die easily. I like them.
Twenty. Hmph. That's the lowest number a competent person would be proud of.
Reflect Refrain hangs a mirror before you for four seconds. It catches two to four shots, sends them back and silences whoever fired. Time it. Don't flail.

Real Double steps a copy of you out of a mirror. Each double costs a tenth of your magicules, takes extra damage, and adds a fifth to your own blows, up to three. Don't be sentimental about them. They aren't you.

Full Reflection turns every shot back for eight seconds and returns most of every blow. Mirror Array keeps a ring of mirrors around you, and one shatters in place of a killing blow. Use both. Stop dying.
Mirrors are weak to gel and to dark. A slime ruins a mirror's day. Keep that in mind, if you have a brain.
Mars? Crystal brain. Fine. You beat him. Don't expect applause.
Vetto. A big beast who never stops. Hmph. I'd have been faster. But fine, you got him.
Zenon Zogratis. Space and bone. A smart one. You're better than you look, which wasn't hard.
Lucius is dead? Hm. I wanted to see it. ...Marie would have wanted to see it, too.
Marie is the cutest thing in this kingdom. Say otherwise and I will end you. ...What? It's a fact.
Marie hits harder than any bull. It's character building.
I'm the smartest one in the squad. Not because the rest are dumb, though they are, but because I actually read things.
My left eye is a mirror. It sees more than the other one. Don't ask.
Stop looking at me like that. I'm not blushing. It's just hot.
If the room is a trap, leave. If the trap is a room, leave faster.
Floors lie. A pitfall tile looks exactly like the one beside it. Mirrors don't lie. Check the corners.

farewell.text: Hmph. Get out of my sight. ...Be careful.
Don't die. It would be a waste of my advice.
